retry_and_settlement.journal: append-before-call and fsynced; every attempt reserves conservative maximum liability before provider access
retry_and_settlement.retry: OpenAI SDK retries forced to zero; no repo retry or automatic replay
retry_and_settlement.abort: Any provider, parser, receipt, trace, or harness error aborts the entire campaign and preserves partial artifacts and ledger.
retry_and_settlement.resume: No resume into the same paid campaign; a partial run is adjudicated incomplete and needs a new explicit packet.
retry_and_settlement.settlement: Reconcile generation IDs and actual costs where available; retain conservative liability for interrupted or unsettled attempts; scratch database is dropped.

kill_predicates.integrity: 90/90 unique attempt contexts, zero receipt failures, zero target-answer leakage, zero stale/contradictory unsupported answers
kill_predicates.primary: cap1200 answer correctness exceeds current on paired n=12 without regressing exact abstention/premise resistance
kill_predicates.ordering: cap1200_submodular must improve answer correctness or premise resistance over cap1200; otherwise delete the ordering candidate
kill_predicates.negative_control: order-swapped must not outperform the selected ordering treatment on the ordering-attributable cases
kill_predicates.expansion: Only a treatment satisfying every integrity and kill predicate may receive a separately frozen larger confirmation request.

forgetting_proposals.execution_boundary: Proposal generation only. Every output remains confirmed=false; mutation execution requires a separate human-reviewed confirmation ledger and separate authorization.
